tools.name: mssql_confirm_appointment
tools.description: [MSSQL] [MSSQL] Confirms an existing patient appointment in the HIS system. IMPORTANT: Use AppointmentNo from the appointment details. Do NOT use SetupID. The appointment is identified using appointment_no and project_id.

appointment_no.description: The AppointmentNo returned by the appointment details tool (NOT SetupID)

LanguageID.description: Language ID (1 for Arabic, 2 for English). Determines which fields are returned.

tools.name: mssql_cancel_appointment
tools.description: [MSSQL] [MSSQL] Cancels an existing patient appointment in the HIS system. IMPORTANT: Use appointment_no (AppointmentNo) returned by the appointment details tool. Do NOT use SetupID. The appointment is uniquely identified using appointment_no and project_id.

appointment_no.description: The appointment number (AppointmentNo) returned by the appointment details tool (NOT SetupID)

LanguageID.description: Language ID (1 for Arabic, 2 for English). Determines which fields are returned.

tools.name: mssql_get_appointment_history
tools.description:
[MSSQL] Retrieve past appointment records for a patient where the patient status is 'Arrived' (i.e., the patient physically visited the clinic/hospital).
                        Use this tool when the user asks about a patient's previous visits, past appointments, or appointment history.
                        patientId is mandatory. All other parameters (doctorId, projectId, clinicId, appointmentDate, patientType, patientOutSA) are optional and default to returning all records.

appointmentDate.description: Appointment date (varchar(100), optional, default: '0' for all dates)

patientOutSA.description: Patient out of SA flag (bit, optional, default: false)

LanguageID.description: Language ID (1 for Arabic, 2 for English). Determines which name fields are returned.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return (optional, default: 1000)

tools.name: mssql_get_GroupedDoctor_Appoinments
tools.description:
[MSSQL] Retrieve past appointment records for a patient where the patient status is 'Arrived' (i.e., the patient physically visited the clinic/hospital).
                        Use this tool when the user asks about a patient's previous visits, past appointments, or appointment history.
                        patientId is mandatory. All other parameters (doctorId, projectId, clinicId, appointmentDate, patientType, patientOutSA) are optional and default to returning all records.

LanguageID.description: Language ID (1 for Arabic, 2 for English). Determines which name fields are returned.

tools.name: mssql_get_upcoming_appointment
tools.description: [MSSQL] DIRECTLY use this tool for upcoming appointment queries. Get upcoming (future) appointment details using HIS_GetAppoimentAll_History stored procedure from MSSQL. Returns only appointments with dates in the future (date >= today). DO NOT use PostgreSQL for appointment data. LanguageID controls which status description field is returned (1=Arabic StatusDescN, 2=English StatusDesc).

LanguageID.description: Language ID (1 for Arabic, 2 for English). Determines which name fields are returned.

tools.name: mssql_get_doctor_free_slots
tools.description: [MSSQL] Get available free time slots for a doctor in a clinic. Returns a list of available appointment slots with dates and times.

days.description: Number of days to look ahead for available slots (default: 90)

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return (optional, default: 1000)

tools.name: mssql_get_nearest_doctor_have_free_slot
tools.description:
[MSSQL] [INDIVIDUAL DOCTOR SLOT SEARCH] 
    Find specific doctors who have available appointment slots. 
    doctorId is optional (defaults to 0 for any doctor in the clinic).
    Use this when you want to check availability for a specific doctor (or set doctorId=0 to search all doctors in the clinic).
    Parameters: projectId, clinicId, doctorId, dateFrom, dateTo

doctorId.description: Doctor ID (0 for any doctor in the clinic)

dateFrom.description: Start date for slot search (DATETIME format). If omitted, defaults to today's date.

dateTo.description: End date for slot search (DATETIME format). If omitted, defaults to 30 days after today's date.

dateTimeStart.description: Start time for daily slot search (VARCHAR(11), optional, e.g., '08:00'). If omitted, defaults to NULL.

dateTimeEnd.description: End time for daily slot search (VARCHAR(11), optional, e.g., '17:00'). If omitted, defaults to NULL.

isNearest.description: Whether to search for nearest doctors (default: false)

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return (optional, default: 1000)

tools.name: mssql_reschudule_getNearestDoctorSlot
tools.description:
[MSSQL] [MSSQL] [RESCHEDULE — DOCTOR SLOT SEARCH]

Use ONLY during appointment rescheduling to find available slots for the same doctor.

Two modes:
1. Nearest available → isNearest = true (omit appointmentDate)
2. Specific date range → isNearest = false (appointmentDate required, format DD-MMM-YYYY e.g. 29-MAY-2026)

Always pass the doctorId,projectid, clinicid and appointmentDate from the existing appointment being rescheduled.

doctorId.description: Doctor ID ( For any doctor in the clinic)

tools.name: mssql_get_nearestClinic_have_doctorSlots
tools.description:
[MSSQL] [CLINIC-WIDE SLOT SEARCH]
    Find clinics where ANY doctors have available appointment slots.
    DOES NOT REQUIRE: doctorId parameter.
    Use this when you want to find clinics with available slots (any doctor).
    Parameters: projectId, clinicId

tools.name: mssql_get_availableDoctors_with_slots_byDate
tools.description:
[MSSQL] [PROJECT CLINIC DOCTOR SLOT SEARCH]
Retrieve doctors within a specific project and clinic who have available appointment slots on a given date.

REQUIRES: projectId, clinicId, date.

Returns doctor-level availability grouped by date.

Date format hint: use 'DD-MMM-YYYY' (e.g., '30-DEC-2025').

tools.name: mssql_get_TopFive_availableDoctors_with_slots_byDate
tools.description:
[MSSQL] [PROJECT CLINIC DOCTOR SLOT SEARCH WITH PAGINATION]
Retrieve doctors within a specific project and clinic who have available appointment slots on a given date.
Supports pagination with 5 results per page.

REQUIRES: projectId, clinicId, date.

Returns doctor-level availability grouped by date with pagination metadata.

Date format hint: use 'DD-MMM-YYYY' (e.g., '30-DEC-2025').

page.description: Page number for pagination (default: 1). Each page returns 5 results.

tools.name: mssql_get_TopFive_nearestClinic_have_doctorSlots
tools.description:
[MSSQL] [CLINIC-WIDE SLOT SEARCH WITH PAGINATION]
    Find clinics where ANY doctors have available appointment slots.
    Same functionality as get_nearestClinic_have_doctorSlots but with pagination support.
    Supports pagination with 5 results per page.
    
    DOES NOT REQUIRE: doctorId parameter.
    Use this when you want to find clinics with available slots (any doctor) with pagination.
    Parameters: projectId, clinicId, page (optional)

page.description: Page number for pagination (default: 1). Each page returns 5 results.

tools.name: mssql_get_clinics_for_project
tools.description: [MSSQL] List clinics for a specific project by querying HIS_CLINIC table. LanguageID determines which fields are returned (1=Arabic returns ClinicID and ClinicDescriptionN, 2=English returns ClinicID and ClinicDescription).

LanguageID.description: Language ID (1 for Arabic, 2 for English). Determines which fields are returned.

tools.name: mssql_get_patient_info
tools.description: [MSSQL] Get patient information from PostgreSQL database. Can search by mobile number or patient ID.

LanguageID.description: Language ID (1 for Arabic, 2 for English). Determines which fields are returned.

tools.name: mssql_get_patient_by_name_dob
tools.description: [MSSQL] Get patient information from PostgreSQL database by searching patient name (Arabic or English) and date of birth. Searches in both full_name_en and full_name_ar columns.

name.description: Patient name to search for (can be Arabic or English, searches in both name columns)

dob.description: Date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format

tools.name: mssql_get_Projects
tools.description: [MSSQL] Get project details by performing a FULL OUTER JOIN between HIS_Project and HIS_Project_HmgVidaPlus tables. Returns complete project information including HMG Vida Plus integration data.

projectId.description: Optional Project ID to filter a specific project

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return (optional, default: 200)

tools.name: mssql_get_SetupId_Projects

projectId.description: Optional Project ID to filter a specific project

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return (optional, default: 200)

tools.name: mssql_get_Projects_from_Location
tools.description: [MSSQL] Get the top 5 projects nearest to a given location (latitude, longitude). Returns project details sorted by distance from the specified coordinates. LanguageID determines which fields are excluded from the response (1=Arabic, 2=English).

LanguageID.description: Language ID (1 for Arabic, 2 for English). Determines which fields are excluded from response.

tools.name: mssql_get_Active_Doctors
tools.description: [MSSQL] Get active doctors from all databases (OLAYA, Rayan, TAKHSUSI, Qassim, Dubai, SWEIDI, KHOBAR) with optional filtering by project and clinic. Returns comprehensive doctor information including clinic details, nationality, gender, and title. Supports pagination with 5 results per page.

projectId.description: Optional Project ID to filter doctors by project (NULL = all projects)

clinicId.description: Optional Clinic ID to filter doctors by clinic (NULL = all clinics)

page.description: Page number for pagination (default: 1). Each page returns 5 results.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return (optional, default: 1000). Note: Pagination uses 5 results per page, so limit is used for total count calculation only.

tools.name: mssql_find_available_slots_help
tools.description: [MSSQL] Help guide for finding available appointment slots. Use this to understand which tool to use for your specific search.

search_type.description: Type of search you want to perform

has_doctor_id.description: Do you have a specific doctor ID?

tools.name: mssql_get_family_members
tools.description: [MSSQL] Get all shared patient records filtered by region. Region: 0=All regions, 1=KSA (Saudi Arabia), 2=OUT KSA (International)

languageId.description: Language ID: 1=Arabic, 2=English (default: 2). Controls which name columns are returned.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (optional, respects MAX_ROWS)

tools.name: mssql_get_patient_doctor_appointments
tools.description:

tools.name: mssql_get_doctor_responses

[MSSQL] [MSSQL] Track Ask Doctor submissions for a patient.

            Returns list of Ask Doctor requests and their responses/status.

tools.description: [API] Book a new appointment

ClinicID.description: Clinic/Facility ID (integer, must be greater than 0). Identifies the specific clinic or healthcare facility where the appointment will take place.

DoctorID.description: Doctor ID (integer, must be greater than 0). Identifies the specific doctor who will see the patient.

LanguageID.description: Language of the conversation: 1=Arabic, 2=English. All returned messages (success and error) are localized based on this value. Defaults to 2 (English) if not provided.

tools.name: api_Rescheduling_book_appointment
tools.description:
[API] [API] [RESCHEDULE] Reschedule an appointment for an existing patient appointment.

Use ONLY during the reschedule flow, AFTER mssql_reschedule_getNearestDoctorSlot has returned an available slot.

AppointmentNo is the ID of the EXISTING appointment being rescheduled (from the patient's current appointment record).

AppointmentDate format: YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2026-08-20).
AppoinmentTime format: HH:MM (e.g. 09:00).

ProjectID.description: Project/Account ID (integer, must be greater than 0). Identifies the healthcare project or account where the appointment is being booked.

ClinicID.description: Clinic/Facility ID (integer, must be greater than 0). Identifies the specific clinic or healthcare facility where the appointment will take place.

DoctorID.description: Doctor ID (integer, must be greater than 0). Identifies the specific doctor who will see the patient.

PatientID.description: Patient ID (integer, must be greater than 0). Identifies the patient for whom the appointment is being booked.

AppoinmentTime.description: Appointment start time (string, cannot be empty). The time when the appointment begins. Format should match the system's expected time format (e.g., 'HH:MM'). This value will also be used for SelectedTime if SelectedTime is not provided.

AppointmentDate.description: Appointment date (string, cannot be empty). The date when the appointment is scheduled. Format should match the system's expected date format (e.g., 'YYYY-MM-DD' or 'DD/MM/YYYY').

tools.name: api_send_medical_report_email
tools.description: [API] Send a medical report (lab, radiology, or procedure report) to a patient via Email or WhatsApp. Requires patient ID, hospital/project ID, invoice number, and doctor/clinic details. The recipient email is auto-populated from the patient record if not provided. Use channel_id=1 for Email (default) or channel_id=2 for WhatsApp delivery. Returns success/failure status from the CS-360 Notifications service.

OrderNo.description: The lab order number. Used only when Reporttype is 1 (Lab). Send 0 or null for other report types.

EpisodeID.description: The visit/episode number. Used only when Reporttype is 3 (Prescriptions). Send 0 or null for other report types.

AdmissionNo.description: The admission number. Used only when Reporttype is 6 (Discharge Summary). Send 0 or null for other report types.

ReportID.description: The unique identifier for the report.

Reporttype.description: Report type: 1=Lab, 2=Radiology, 3=Prescriptions, 4=Medical Out-Patient, 5=Medical In-Patient, 6=Discharge Summary, 7=Sick Leave, 8=Covid Certificate, 9=Vaccine Report, 10=Dental Treatment Plan
